intro.title: A small habit. A bigger consequence.
intro.description: We often take antibiotics without thinking twice. But what happens when we use them when they aren't needed?

scene1.title: Feeling a little unwell?
scene1.description: A common cold, a sore throat or a minor problem. Sometimes we reach for leftover antibiotics without consulting a healthcare professional.

scene2.title: A microscopic world awaits.
scene2.description: Let's follow the journey of an antibiotic and discover what can happen to bacteria when they are exposed to it.
